locator.section: pinned source key Sancti/11-01; resolved section [Secreta] with declared inherited references

entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.
RG 115 a supplies the full Per Dominum conclusion and Amen for this declared proper-body and formula composite; the proper page prints only the abbreviated cue.
The Benziger 1962 printing supplies the All Saints Secret proper through reddantur and the abbreviated Per Dominum cue; the separately cited RG 115 a supplies the full conclusion.

The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
